A '''battle''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Revyia]] when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] attacked and destroyed a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Revyia smuggler base|base]] located deep within the planet's jungles.
